headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.

headlines.title: 三菱日联预计美联储本月加息25基点，10月将按兵不动
headlines.summary: 三菱日联放弃了对于美联储今年维持利率不变的预估，预计央行将在9月加息25个基点。 策略师George Goncalves和Agron Nicaj调整预期的理由包括美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔发表的偏鹰讲话、8月就业数据稳健，以及周五公布的CPI高于预期。 策略师写道，加息有可能成为一次“政策错误”，但在市场已经预期美联储下周加息的情况下，美联储很难选择按兵不动。他们表示：“鉴于沃什反复强调‘通胀是选项之一’，如果他什么都不做，会带来问题。”

headlines.title_en: Mitsubishi UFJ expects the Fed to raise rates by 25 basis points this month and hold steady in October
headlines.summary_en: Mitsubishi UFJ abandoned its forecast that the Federal Reserve will keep rates unchanged this year, expecting the central bank to raise rates by 25 basis points in September. Strategists George Goncalves and Agron Nicaj cited Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole, solid August employment data, and Friday's higher-than-expected CPI as reasons for the revised outlook. The strategists wrote that a rate hike could prove to be a "policy mistake," but with the market already expecting the Fed to raise rates next week, it would be difficult for the Fed to choose to stand pat. "Given Warsh's repeated emphasis that 'inflation is one of the options,' it would create problems if he did nothing," they said.

headlines.title: 美国2026财年前11个月预算赤字累计达到1.96万亿美元
headlines.summary: 美国联邦政府本财年前11个月预算赤字达到1.96万亿美元，为有记录以来最高水平之一。财政部周五公布的数据显示，截至8月的11个月，赤字较2025年同期的1.97万亿美元小幅下降。单看8月，财赤缺口为1,668亿美元。财年最后一个月（即9月）通常会因为企业缴税期限而录得盈余。赤字扩大的部分原因是债务利息支出上升，而美债收益率上涨又是利息成本走高的原因之一。 财政部数据显示，截至8月底，可交易美国国债的平均利率升至3.48%，比五年前高出逾2个百分点。随着低收益率债券陆续到期，财政部不得不以更高成本再融资，这一平均利率预计还会继续上升。

headlines.title_en: U.S. budget deficit reaches $1.96 trillion cumulatively in the first 11 months of fiscal 2026
headlines.summary_en: The US federal government's budget deficit reached $1.96 trillion in the first 11 months of the fiscal year, one of the highest levels on record. Treasury Department data released Friday showed the deficit for the 11 months through August edged down from $1.97 trillion in the same period of 2025. For August alone, the fiscal gap was $166.8 billion. The final month of the fiscal year (September) typically posts a surplus due to corporate tax deadlines. Part of the reason for the widening deficit is rising debt interest expenses, and higher US Treasury yields are one reason for the higher interest costs. Treasury data showed that as of the end of August, the average rate on marketable US Treasuries rose to 3.48%, more than 2 percentage points higher than five years ago. As low-yield bonds gradually mature, the Treasury must refinance at higher costs, and this average rate is expected to continue rising.

headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs: Maintains end-2026 gold price forecast of $4,900, with upside risks skewed higher
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs continues to believe its forecast of gold reaching $4,900 per ounce by the end of 2026 faces net upside risk, but two-way volatility along the path will also increase. Goldman said its fair-value forecast of $4,900 per ounce by the end of 2026 assumes continued strong central bank demand. If ETF investor inflows recover and currently elevated bullish options positioning persists, dealer hedging could mechanically amplify the rally and push gold prices well beyond its forecast. Goldman also said that if expectations for Fed rate hikes rekindle, it could trigger dealers to unwind hedges, causing a sharper pullback in gold prices than usual.

headlines.title: 提高资本市场制度包容性 吸引优质企业扎根A股
headlines.summary: 【提高资本市场制度包容性 吸引优质企业扎根A股】在近日召开的国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超介绍了“十五五”时期资本市场改革的相关部署，其中提到，要持续深化投融资综合改革，进一步提高制度包容性、适应性，努力将A股市场打造为境内优质企业上市首选地。这不仅是资本市场未来一段时间的改革重点，更是推动资本市场在国家创新生态系统中发挥重要作用的使命担当。

headlines.title_en: Enhance the inclusiveness of the capital market system to attract high-quality enterprises to take root in A-shares
headlines.summary_en: [Enhancing the institutional inclusiveness of the capital market to attract quality enterprises to take root in A-shares] At a recent State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao outlined the relevant arrangements for capital market reform during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, mentioning the need to continue deepening comprehensive investment and financing reform, further improve institutional inclusiveness and adaptability, and strive to make the A-share market the preferred listing destination for quality domestic enterprises. This is not only a reform priority for the capital market for some time to come, but also a mission and responsibility to promote the capital market's important role in the national innovation ecosystem.

headlines.title: 中方警告勿随意扩大苏丹制裁范围
headlines.summary: 中国常驻联合国代表团临时代办孙磊11日在安理会表决苏丹制裁问题决议草案后作解释性发言，警告不要随意扩大制裁范围。 孙磊说，考虑到安理会成员间分歧明显，执笔国美国提出对苏丹达尔富尔地区采取的制裁措施授权进行一个月的技术性延期，使大家有更充分时间讨论，中方对此不持异议，在表决中投了赞成票。中方一贯主张要确保决议草案的客观性、公正性和包容性，避免强推争议明显的案文。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: China warns against arbitrarily expanding the scope of Sudan sanctions
headlines.summary_en: Sun Lei, Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, delivered an explanatory statement on September 11 after the Security Council voted on a draft resolution on Sudan sanctions, warning against arbitrarily expanding the scope of sanctions. Sun Lei said that given the obvious differences among Security Council members, the penholder the United States proposed a one-month technical extension of the authorization for sanctions measures against Sudan's Darfur region to allow more time for discussion, and China had no objection to this and voted in favor. China has consistently advocated ensuring the objectivity, impartiality and inclusiveness of draft resolutions and avoiding forcing through texts with obvious controversies. (Xinhua)

headlines.summary_en: This week, the S&P fell 0.4%, the Dow fell 1.5%, and the Nasdaq fell 0.5%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 0.6%, the memory chip index fell 1.2%, the Magnificent Seven tech stocks fell 0.1%, and the rate-cut winners index fell 3.7%. On Friday, when the US CPI inflation data was released, the S&P 500 initially closed up 0.8%, with telecom, technology and industrial sectors rising at least about 1%, while utilities fell 0.3%.
